title: Preparation for Delivery from Supplier
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.9 and Section 6 (Contingency Steps) of SOP-01-A, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 89-93 = PDF pages 95-99). Step text is the Key Step column verbatim. Section 3 (Responsibility), 5 (Process Flow Diagram) and 7 (Documentation and Attachments) are not steps. Built under docs/annotation-codebook.md. 4.7 (inform) and 4.8 (send) are siblings off 4.6: both need the approved schedule, neither needs the other (R3). Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Receive Request for Schedule of Delivery (RSD) from suppliers filled-up via manual process, email, or via the electronic logistics management information system (eLMIS) if available
Verify completeness of information of RSD including required documentations (as necessary)

Reject request and perform contingency step 6.1: fill out the Non-conformance Report (Annex 3), have the requesting personnel co-sign the form, provide a copy to the requesting party before departure and instruct to request for a new schedule of delivery
steps.condition: the delivery documents are incomplete or inappropriate

steps.text: Collate all RSDs for review of the Supply Officer
steps.condition: the delivery documents are complete and appropriate

steps.text: Review and classify RSDs based on the following: Space Availability, Notice to Proceed, Urgency
Perform contingency step 6.2: requests for deliveries which cannot be accommodated shall be re-scheduled accordingly
steps.condition: the requested delivery cannot be accommodated

steps.text: Approve Requests for Deliveries and generate the Approved RSD form specifying the date and time of delivery of suppliers
Inform Supplier, Donor, Store Manager and Inspection Committee of the Approved Schedule/s of delivery
Send Schedules of Delivery, Request for Inspection to Store managers and Inspection Committee
Prepare the warehouse and staff for the upcoming delivery
